name: Vernalis
tagline: The countertop farm that actually feeds you dinner.
positioning: Vernalis is a self-watering vertical garden and companion app that grows herbs, greens, and micro-veg on your kitchen counter — no green thumb required.

hero.h1: Grow real food where your fruit bowl used to be.
hero.sub: Vernalis is a three-tier hydroponic garden the size of a toaster. Drop in a seed pod, fill the tank, and harvest basil, kale, and cherry tomatoes in weeks — the app handles the rest.

features.title: Pods, not seeds packets
features.description: Pre-sown biodegradable pods snap into any tier. No soil, no measuring, no guessing which seedling is a weed.

features.title: It waters itself
features.description: The 2.4L reservoir feeds nutrients on a schedule tuned to each plant. You'll get a nudge when it's thirsty — roughly every 10 days.

features.title: Light that follows the sun
features.description: Full-spectrum LEDs ramp up at dawn and dim at dusk, so your parsley thinks it's on a Tuscan hillside, not your counter.

features.title: Harvest reminders that land
features.description: The app tells you when each pod peaks — 'your arugula is ready, eat it in the next 3 days' — so nothing bolts or wilts unpicked.

features.title: Grow logs you'll actually keep
features.description: Every batch gets a timeline: germination, first true leaves, first snip. Repeat what worked, retire what bolted.

features.title: Pods for every craving
features.description: From Thai basil to rainbow chard to wildflower mixes for pollinators — over 60 varieties, delivered to fit right in the tray.

testimonials.quote: I killed four store-bought basil plants before this. Vernalis is on its ninth harvest and I've stopped buying herbs entirely. My pesto game is genuinely out of control now.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni

testimonials.quote: We put one in the break room as a joke. Now the whole team fights over the mint for their tea and nobody remembers whose turn it is to top up the tank.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: As someone in a fourth-floor apartment with north-facing windows, this is the first time I've grown anything edible indoors that didn't turn into a sad stick.
testimonials.name: Dana Okoro

pricing.blurb: A single-tier garden for herbs and greens — perfect for one counter.
The three-tier flagship for people who want salad, not garnish.
Two towers and a season plan for the household that meal-preps.

homepage.footerBlurb: Vernalis makes countertop vertical gardens for people who want to grow real food, not admire a houseplant. Rooted in earnest, grown at home.
